company.name: Rain AI
company.shortDescription: Rain AI develops an energy-efficient hardware for artificial intelligence (AI) applications.
company.description: Rain AI is a semiconductor company specializing in developing energy-efficient hardware for artificial intelligence (AI) applications. Rain AI focuses on creating neuromorphic chips inspired by the human brain's architecture. The company's hardware is designed to be more energy-efficient than traditional AI processors, addressing the growing demand for sustainable computing solutions.  Rain AI's technology is adaptable across various AI applications, from data centers to edge devices, facilitating widespread adoption.

aiResearchSummary.text: Rain AI is researching energy-efficient hardware for AI applications, focusing on compute-in-memory architectures as described in 'Tiled in-memory computing architecture' and 'Architecture for ai accelerator platform.' These efforts include compute engines with CIM modules for storing weights and performing vector-matrix multiplication, flexible microarchitectures, and methods for efficient 3D SRAM-based compute-in-memory, all aimed at enhancing AI accelerator platforms and continuous on-chip learning.
